verdict.rationale: Insomnia's docs explicitly list OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 as a supported import format (alongside Postman, HAR, Swagger, WSDL, cURL), which generates requests/collections in the app, and separate docs describe building/iterating on OpenAPI specs within the tool. missing for 10: no explicit first-party walkthrough showing the generated collection/request tree from an imported spec, and no independent hands-on verification of import fidelity.
